$comment: Spend caps are off by default (null = no limit), by the owner's choice. The owner can set one in Settings. There is no cap on how many agents work (the owner, 2026-11-12, decision 288): a goal gets the team plan_team sizes from its parts, or the owner's number, and AWS quotas are the only limit (the dispatcher backs off on throttling; max_new_sessions_per_second keeps under AgentCore's session creation rate). worker_idle_release_minutes: a worker with no turn for this long and nothing moving goes home (released by the sweep), paused city included. Hard ceilings that hold even if prompts fail: max_open_jobs (delegate_to_orchestrator), max_departments (create_department; it counts only the owner's own departments beyond the twelve pre-configured ones, which always exist); all owner-editable in Settings.
